title: initiative-burnup-dashboard-for-sdk-cohorts-and-onramp-health
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight Initiative Burnup Dashboard that surfaces progress and health for the Developer Experience programs (SDKs, docs, quickstarts) across cohorts and cycles. The dashboard should enable PMs and leadership to: 1) visualize initiative milestone burnup vs. planned timeline, 2) correlate adoption signal funnels (onboard -> first API call -> retention) for each SDK cohort, 3) expose OKR-level rollups (activation, time-to-first-success, retention) and the underlying tickets driving variance, and 4) provide an at-a-glance risk score and recommended mitigations for initiatives drifting off-target. This ticket scopes the MVP dashboard (table + burnup chart + cohort funnel + risk indicators) and a release plan for an initial 6-week rollout to devx PMs and Solutions teams.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays milestone burnup for at least 3 active initiatives (SDK core, Quickstarts refresh, Docs samples) with daily data refresh
Cohort funnel visualization for SDK onboarding cohorts (signup -> install -> first API call -> 7-day retention) selectable by cohort tag
OKR rollup card shows current value, target, delta, and contributing tickets with links
Risk score computed from schedule slippage, open blocker count, and customer-impact label and surfaced with remediation suggestions
Permissions gated to PMs, program managers, and leadership group; read-only for general staff
Documentation (Confluence) and a 30-minute walkthrough recorded and linked in the ticket
next_steps: Finalize telemetry contract with Data (ENG-4821) - field names and refresh cadence
Sketch wireframe and get design quick feedback (DES review slot scheduled)
Prototype burnup + funnel in Metabase and validate with 2 pilot PMs
Add cohort tagging to SDK onboarding events and backfill 90 days of data
